g.text: ORIGINAL SETTLEMENT / PROTECTED ACCOUNT GATE / COHERENT RECOVERY

text.tspan: Lost account responses / mixed snapshots / old worker schedules
Original receipt joins / one application / retained shared reservations
No new identity from a retry
New worker is a new proposer
Accepted original may finish after fence
Restored database is a derived view
Repair creates no new financial effect
No new slot from local absence
No refund or new spendable envelope
